chunks: And from him, from Sa'id ibn Isma'il, from his father, who said:
I asked al-Rida (peace be upon him) about a man who married a woman on the condition that they do not inherit from each other and that he does not seek children from her. He said, 'I do not like it.'

key_terms.اَلرِّضَا: Al-Rida (peace be upon him), the eighth Imam

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marriage conditions that exclude inheritance and procreation in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) expressed disapproval ('la ahibbu') of marriage contracts stipulating no inheritance and no procreation, reflecting the Shia scholarly view that these conditions contradict the essential purposes (maqasid) of nikah. This response highlights the preference for preserving the natural social and biological objectives of marriage, distinguishing between conditions that invalidate the contract and those merely discouraged for their deviation from ideal marital conduct.
